data.gender_notes: Sharank is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from theShankara', which means Lord Shiva, the deity of destruction and transformation. The name Sharank carries the meaning “Lord Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharank usually hope their child will grow to embody lord shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name 'Sharank' imbues the spiritual significance of transformation and destruction. It symbolizes the power to let go of the old and welcome the new, allowing for growth and evolution in one's personal and spiritual journey.
